title: Touhou Seirensen ~ Undefined Fantastic Object - Ballet Of The Ghost Girl's Ship ~ Interdimensional Voyage of a Ghostly Passenger Ship (Remix)
description:
𝐼'𝓂 𝒽𝑒𝒶𝒹𝑒𝒹 𝓉𝑜𝓌𝒶𝓇𝒹𝓈 𝒶 𝒸𝑜𝓂𝓅𝓁𝑒𝓉𝑒𝓁𝓎 𝓈𝓊𝒷𝓂𝑒𝓇𝑔𝑒𝒹 𝒶𝓃𝒹 𝓈𝑜𝓇𝓇𝑜𝓌𝒻𝓊𝓁 𝒽𝑒𝓁𝓁.
𝒯𝒽𝑜𝓈𝑒 𝓌𝒽𝑜 𝒸𝒶𝓃'𝓉 𝓂𝒶𝓀𝑒 𝓊𝓈𝑒 𝑜𝒻 𝓉𝒽𝑒 𝓌𝒶𝓉𝑒𝓇 𝓌𝑜𝓊𝓁𝒹 𝒿𝓊𝓈𝓉 𝑔𝑒𝓉 𝒾𝓃 𝓂𝓎 𝓌𝒶𝓎.
𝐸𝓋𝑒𝓃 𝒾𝒻 𝒾𝓉'𝓈 𝐿𝒶𝒹𝓎 𝐻𝒾𝒿𝒾𝓇𝒾.

Did an arrangement of Interdimensional Voyage of a Ghostly Passenger Ship from Touhou 12: Undefined Fantastic Object. Probably the best sunken ship stage theme of all-time, which isn't saying much 'cuz there aren't that many. Seriously, though, this song goes incredibly hard and is easily one of my favorite songs from this game!!!

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. F Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. E Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables "Windows-Pop-Esque" sound [turned on default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables "Windows-Pop-Esque" sound
